settings.lang.title: Language and region
settings.lang.intro: GifOS follows your browser’s language unless you choose one here. Apps that support languages follow it too. Changes apply as you make them, on every GifOS page in this browser.
settings.lang.untranslated: GifOS’s own words are in English for now. Dates, times and numbers already follow your choice.
settings.ai.help: Apps that ask for AI use what you pick here. A key stays in this browser and is not included in a shared backup. A Provider app in your Providers folder can answer on this device with no key.
settings.accounts.name: Name
settings.accounts.help: A short name, the service’s address, and your key. GifOS sends the key only to that service, and only saves it after a test succeeds. Deepgram is spoken directly. If another service blocks the browser, GifOS retries through a proxy (<m>{proxy}</m>) and remembers that — those requests pass through that proxy in flight. Your own proxy address stays under Custom proxy.
settings.accounts.offlineSaved: ✗ you appear to be offline — this API is still set up; test again when the connection returns
settings.accounts.offlineNew: ✗ you appear to be offline — connect to test and save
settings.accounts.wsFailed: ✗ could not open its WebSocket — a wrong key and a blocked network look the same here; check both
settings.accounts.proxyTrying: blocked directly — trying the CORS proxy…
settings.accounts.unreachable: ✗ can’t reach it directly or through the proxy — network or CORS, not your key
settings.accounts.removeBody: Remove {name} from this computer? The service itself is not changed.
settings.pay.forget: Forget this purchase on this computer (the payment is not refunded)
settings.pay.count: {n, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} · {total} total
settings.pay.leadSome: Charges you approved on this computer. Apps never see your card, wallet, or balance. Forgetting a purchase only clears it from this computer and does not refund it. The ceiling is the most one charge from that app may ask for.
settings.pay.leadNone: Nothing charged on this computer. Apps never see your card, wallet, or balance.
settings.storage.unavailable: Storage details unavailable in this browser.
settings.storage.protectedLine: Protected — the browser won't clear this Home Screen to free space.
settings.storage.notProtectedLine: Not yet protected. GifOS asks automatically; browsers grant it once a site is used a bit. You can also keep a backup GIF (GifOS menu → Back up Home Screen).

settings.you.intro: Friends see this name when you play or work together. It stays on this computer.
settings.you.name: Name
settings.you.pictureHelp: Friends see this when your camera is off. An animated GIF stays animated.
settings.you.pictureErr: Choose a GIF, PNG, JPG, or WebP.
settings.look.intro: Changes apply as you make them, on every GifOS page in this browser.
settings.look.textSizeHelp: GifOS’s own text — icon labels, menus, this window. Inside an app, that app’s own controls still apply.
settings.storage.title: Storage
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.conn.title: Invite connection
settings.erase.title: Erase this computer
settings.erase.sub: Wipes apps and files in this browser
settings.storage.lead: Your desktop lives entirely in this browser.
settings.updates.running: Running v{version}. Checking gifos.app for the latest…
settings.conn.intro: This is how invite links find each other. Leave the field blank to keep the standard connection, <m>wss://relay.gifos.app</m>. Test checks that address. A change applies to apps you open afterwards.
settings.conn.ph: Leave blank to keep the standard one
settings.conn.noAnswer: No answer after 8 seconds — this address cannot be reached from here.
settings.conn.failed: Could not connect. If you did not set this yourself, try again in a moment; if you run your own service, check that it is live on this domain.
settings.storage.declined: The browser declined for now — nothing was lost. It grants this once the site is used more. You can try again.
settings.updates.offlineBody: You appear to be offline. Reconnect and try again — the unreleased build has to download from the site.
settings.pin.riskEdge1: It is unreleased: it changes without notice and can have bugs that break apps or meetings.
settings.pin.riskEdge2: Things you save on it may not open the same way on the latest release.
settings.pin.riskEdge3: People on the latest release may not be able to join your meetings, or you theirs.
settings.pin.riskOld1: It is older than the latest release and misses its fixes, including security fixes.
settings.pin.riskOld2: Apps and files made with newer releases may not work on it. Meetings still run on the latest release.
settings.pin.riskOldNoBanner: v{version} was made before the header shows a pin. To come back, choose “Use latest” in its Settings, or visit gifos.app/?latest.
settings.pin.riskOldBanner: The header will say you are pinned, with Back to current release right there.
settings.pin.ack: I understand the risks and I’m testing GifOS
settings.pin.holdHelp: Press and hold the button to switch.
settings.pin.intro: This is for people testing GifOS before a release. Most people should stay on the latest release.
settings.pin.endedExpired: This computer’s switch to {what} has ended, so it runs the latest release again. Your files, apps and settings are untouched. Testers can switch again in Settings → System → Updates → Advanced / testing.
settings.pin.endedReset: This computer was set to {what}. That is now only for people testing GifOS, so it runs the latest release again. Your files, apps and settings are untouched. Testers can switch again in Settings → System → Updates → Advanced / testing.
settings.updates.couldntCheck: Couldn’t check which release is latest.
settings.updates.onEdge: This computer is on the edge build.
settings.updates.pinnedTo: This computer is pinned to v{version}.
settings.updates.edgeHelp: The unreleased build at the site root, ahead of every release. You can jump to the latest, but edge builds aren’t archived — you can’t pin or roll back to a specific one.
settings.updates.testingHelp: For people testing GifOS before it is released. Most people never need this. Every switch asks you to confirm. A pin stays until you come back.
settings.updates.offlineBad: Couldn’t reach gifos.app to check the latest release — you may be offline. The snapshots below still work.
settings.updates.pinNote: Type an older release number exactly, like {example}.
